title: PPTX Visual Notes Cleanup: raw prompt labels stop shipping

claims.summary: The release starts from the fresh deployed v0.15.107 UX audit where the ZIP exported 74/C because Slide Deck PPTX notes carried raw SUGGESTED VISUAL and ALT TEXT labels.
PPTX exports now use clean visual guidance and accessibility description text in speaker notes instead of raw prompt-like marker labels.
The deep quality grader now fails raw PPTX visual-planning note labels directly while allowing legitimate UX capstone-presentation course deliverables.
Focused regressions prove old raw labels are blocked, new clean notes preserve accessibility text, and explicit prompt-artifact labels remain guarded.
The release explicitly does not claim strict-clean provider output until a fresh deployed v0.15.108 ZIP/log audit proves the export and grader behavior in real generated materials.

carryForward: Fresh deployed v0.15.108 ZIP/log audit must verify raw PPTX visual-planning labels no longer appear in real provider output.
Texture remains below strict-clean at 95 in the v0.15.107 audit.
